headline: As of 2026-10-30: 45,261,657 early/mail ballots cast nationally across 48 of 50 states, D+9.6 cast-ballot lean.
bullets: 45,261,657 early/mail ballots cast so far across 48 states reporting.
Across party-registration states, ballots cast lean D+9.6 by registration.
Most ballots cast: Texas (6,390,470), California (4,643,370), Florida (4,271,949).
